name: inventory-lookup
description: Look up chemical and personal inventory records using query overrides and inventory search hints.

name: record-lookup
description: Look up project, protocol, notebook, workflow, assay, and gel-related records from local agent data.

name: protocol-matching
description: Rank local protocols against protocol candidates and select the best protocol for notebook generation.

name: notebook-generation
description: Generate a protocol-based notebook draft using a selected protocol, project context, and placeholder values.

name: notebook-draft
description: Propose a likely next experiment, optionally using prior record/literature evidence, prepare a planned biology notebook draft, and wait for explicit confirmation before creating the page.

name: python-sandbox
description: Run agent-authored Python code in an isolated sandbox with staged input files, chat-visible text/image outputs, and readback artifacts. The managed sandbox helper will try to repair failing runs itself, and you can resume the same helper later with feedback by passing its sub_agent_id. Inside the sandbox, import hikari_sandbox to read files and emit renderable outputs.

name: command-line
description: Run a local shell command in the project workspace, capture stdout and stderr, and return the exit status. Prefer this for focused local CLI inspection or execution when Python is unnecessary.

name: web-search
description: Search the public web through the agent's shared web-search transport. This uses provider-native web search when available, or Codex agent search when the agent runs on Codex.

name: sub-agent
description: Create, message, inspect, list, and delete Codex CLI-backed helper sub-agent sessions managed outside the main agent.

name: memory
description: Recall, remember, forget, and list sparse long-term user memory records across sessions.

name: container
description: Store, name, read, update, and position-edit temporary string or number containers with short runtime IDs.

name: literature-search
description: Search literature across PubMed, Crossref, UniProt, Europe PMC, or generic web results with scholarly-first auto fallback. The workflow searches candidates, downloads selected PDFs, writes LLM-facing paper markdown, and loads bounded paper context; when the caller is Codex, the markdown-reading and context-selection step runs in a real Codex sub-agent session. Prefer compact keyword or entity-style queries such as `MAPK inhibitor resistance mechanism` instead of full-sentence prompts, and use preferred source hints when you want one literature database or web domain ranked ahead of the defaults.

name: purchase-recommendation
description: Search the web for purchasable products, extract vendor page metadata such as image and price, hard-filter explicit product requirements, and rank valid items for chat recommendation cards.

name: paper-download
description: Extract a downloadable paper PDF URL, stream the file into app storage with progress tracking, and fall back to a browser-assisted download session when sites block automated fetches.

name: paper-analysis
description: Summarize a paper briefly, extract protocol-relevant methods, and optionally draft a generated protocol from the paper.

name: paper-search
description: Full-text search across the LLM-facing paper wiki (per-paper `paper.md` files in the local KnowledgeBase). Returns ranked section matches with title, DOI, section heading, page citation, and a snippet. Scope the search to a single paper, a project, or a journal club when relevant.

name: protocol-generation
description: Normalize a supplied protocol JSON object into the app's import-ready protocol format without an internal LLM call, and save it into the Hikari Protocols module when save is true.
